title: ARK: Avoiding Routing Collisions for KV Cache Transfer in Disaggregated LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.41160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Disaggregated LLM inference separates the prefill and decode phases across GPU pools, generating massive KV-cache transfers. Because these transfers last hundreds of milliseconds to seconds, they behave as mega elephant flows that dominate link bandwidth utilization. In this regime, stateless ECMP can perform poorly: hash collisions may overload one spine link while leaving others idle, stretching transfer times by seconds. Yet this same persistence makes coordination practical. Since these flows are long-lived, even lightweight one-to-all coordination can be amortized over their lifetime. We present ARK, a distributed elephant-flow path reservation mechanism. ARK coordinates senders to choose source ports whose hashes map concurrent flows onto distinct spines, without requiring switch changes or receiver-side packet reordering. Packet-level RDMA simulations show that ARK reduces mean and P95 FCT by up to 27.3% and 34.0% under moderate

translated_title: ARK：在解耦式LLM推理中避免KV缓存传输的路由冲突
translated_abstract: 解耦式LLM推理将预填充和解码阶段分离到不同的GPU池中，从而产生大规模的KV缓存传输。由于这些传输持续数百毫秒到数秒，它们表现为巨型大象流，主导着链路带宽利用率。在这种场景下，无状态ECMP可能表现不佳：哈希冲突可能导致一条脊链路过载而其他链路闲置，使传输时间延长数秒。然而，这种流的长时存续特性也使得协调机制变得切实可行。由于这些流生命周期较长，即使是一对所有的轻量级协调，其开销也可以在其存续期间被摊销。我们提出了ARK，一种分布式大象流路径预留机制。ARK协调发送方选择源端口，使其哈希将并发流映射到不同的脊交换机上，且无需修改交换机或在接收端进行数据包重排序。数据包级的RDMA仿真表明，在中度负载下，ARK可将平均FCT和P95 FCT分别降低高达27.3%和34.0%。
tldr: ARK是一种面向解耦式LLM推理的分布式大象流路径预留机制，通过协调发送方选择哈希映射到不同脊交换机的源端口来避免ECMP哈希冲突，无需交换机改动即可将KV缓存传输的平均和P95流完成时间分别降低高达27.3%和34.0%。
en_tdlr: ARK is a distributed elephant-flow path reservation mechanism for disaggregated LLM inference that coordinates senders to choose source ports whose hashes map concurrent flows onto distinct spines, avoiding ECMP hash collisions without switch changes and reducing mean and P95 FCT of KV cache transfers by up to 27.3% and 34.0%.
